author: unusual_whales
text:
BREAKING: Louisiana Governor Jeff Landry has declared a state of emergency in Louisiana as diesel prices rise to record levels during peak harvest season.

Landry issued an executive order temporarily allowing dyed diesel, typically reserved for off-road vehicles, to be used in certain highway vehicles.
